articles.title: How The SITE Centers (SITC) Story Is Reset Around Liquidation Value And Asset Sales
articles.summary: The latest analyst update cuts SITE Centers' fair value estimate from US$10.50 to US$6.50 per share, a sharp reset in the target range you might be using to frame upside and downside. Research notes now describe shares as trading close to an estimated liquidation value of about US$6.40, which is why several firms have shifted toward a more neutral stance around the US$6.50 target. As you read on, you will see how this revised price target fits into the evolving narrative around SITE Centers...
